claims.text: DeLonge names the Lockheed leg himself. On 22 February 2016, under the subject 'Advisors', he wrote to Podesta: 'Mr. Weiss from Lockheed SkunkWorks just emailed me asking if there were any updates. I am not expecting much, but if there is anything I can tell him and the General, however small, I would like to respectfully pass it along.'
